checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: The source emission/conjugation and rotation choices are consistent. The compared Hilbert space contains direction, helicity and final spin for one fixed transition energy and one common normalized radial/energy mode, or angular-shell space. It does not bound arbitrary temporal or non-gamma changes.

Full phi integration gives m=m_prime. The same final M_f then forces M_i=M_i_prime. Full-sphere D orthogonality and CG normalization give V_lambda_dagger V_lambda_prime = delta_lambda_lambda_prime I. This controls every initial off-diagonal matrix element, including coherence.

For the same L and opposite E/M pi, one half of the sum over q of q^(pi+pi_prime) vanishes in the physical helicity basis. No fictitious E/M flag is used. This kinematic statement does not allow both same-L types in a definite-parity link, and does not remove fixed-direction interference.

S is the common integrated photon-rate factor for every M_i. Positive S and S_R, with e=S_O/S<1, define V_R. V_O requires S_O>0; when e=0 use V=V_R directly. At e=1 or S=0 the corresponding normalized reference is undefined.

checks.topic: exact full trace distance for arbitrary same density
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: U=[V_R,V_O] is isometric and embeds K(e) tensor rho. K^2=e I and positive trace-one rho give absolute difference sqrt(e) I_2 tensor rho and exact D=sqrt(e) before reduction. Complex sector phases and initial coherence do not change the proof.

checks.topic: common CPTP reduction and effect bound
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: A CPTP dual is positive and unital, so it maps effects to effects. The same reduction/channel or finite-bin effect therefore gives absolute event-probability error <=sqrt(e). This normalized state comparison does not supply width, yield or lifetime errors.

The source finite cap has retained probability 19/64 and difference (3/32)(-e+sqrt(3)*sqrt(e(1-e))), with leading order sqrt(e). An abstract coherent-sector Helstrom effect saturates the distance, but ordinary-bin implementation is not asserted. This particular cap is blind at e=3/4.

For the same trace-nonincreasing CP accepted map and p,q>0, a fixed failure flag completes a CPTP map and gives (||A-B||_1+|p-q|)/2<=d. The normalization triangle gives both d/p and d/q, hence min(1,d/max(p,q)) without another factor 2. Zero success leaves a normalized state undefined.

F=diag(e,1) is a valid filter for 0<e<1. Its success probabilities are p=e(1+e-e^2), q=e^2, and conditional D^2=1/(1+e-e^2), which tends to 1. This is a mathematical family of filters, not a fixed detector. Polarization requires accepted-event normalization and its expectation difference is bounded by 2 D_cond.

Point-density evaluation is not an effect bounded by I. A finite-bin density average divides the probability bound by its angular measure. Independent CG signs confirm the retained M1/E2 node at ratio -sqrt(105)/15; the full M3 node intensity is (3/4)e. The retained zero has no finite relative-error denominator.

The same bounded forward response and physical efficiency in [0,1] give an effect. Inverse weighting or unfolding can exceed unit operator norm and requires conditioning/noise control. Known scalar E_actual=eta P recovers the effect mean after division by eta, while sample and calibration errors can still be amplified.

Unknown but common rho is allowed. Different initial densities require min(1,sqrt(e)+D(rho,rho_0)) by the triangle inequality and V_R isometry. At e=0 orthogonal initial M states can still have full radiation distance 1; common partial traces can only reduce it.

checks.topic: sum omitted rate and model/channel limitations
checks.grounding_and_retained_boundary: e is the sum of omitted photon rates divided by all photon rates for one fixed link. An E4/E2 pair ratio, selection rules or qR alone do not establish e. Changing widths, time modes or non-gamma branches lies outside the common energy/radial-mode theorem.

Source amplitude, phase and integrated-rate premises are directly grounded. The radiation-space, trace-distance and conditional analysis are explicitly our derivation. No source-authored quantum-information theorem, experiment, real-nucleus realization or Human review is claimed.

supported_relations.operator_Gram: V_lambda_dagger V_lambda_prime = delta_lambda_lambda_prime I_initial after full Ω, q and final M_f summation.
supported_relations.full_D: D(V rho V_dagger,V_R rho V_R_dagger)=sqrt(e) for the same positive trace-one initial rho.
supported_relations.reduced_and_effect: The same CPTP reduction gives D<=sqrt(e); the same effect 0<=E<=I gives absolute probability error <=sqrt(e).
supported_relations.conditional: For the same trace-nonincreasing accepted CP map with p,q>0, D(A/p,B/q)<=min(1,d/max(p,q)).
supported_relations.changed_initial: The comparison is bounded by min(1,sqrt(e)+D_initial) if the initial density changes.

required_reuse_boundaries: Use the full sphere, both helicities and final spin for the Gram identity; do not infer absence of fixed-direction interference. Same-L E/M kinematic orthogonality does not override parity selection.

Keep one fixed good-spin transition and photon energy with the same normalized radial/time mode or angular-shell space. Recomputed widths, lifetimes, arrival-time modes, non-gamma decay and other branches are not bounded here.
Use the same positive trace-one initial density and the same effect, channel or instrument. A changed fitted density adds D_initial; different responses require a separate comparison.
Require S>0, S_R>0 and e<1. Define V_O only when S_O>0. At e=0 use V=V_R; at e=1 or S=0 there is no corresponding normalized reference.
Bound the sum of all omitted photon rates, not one E4/E2 pair ratio or qR. Integrated rate loss and renormalized probability error are distinct quantities.
The universal sqrt(e) bound concerns absolute bounded-event probability or CPTP state distance. It is not a relative point-density, normalized polarization or noisy unfolded-estimate bound.
Conditional states require p,q>0 and a useful success floor. The CPTP completion uses one fixed failure state. The rare filter is a mathematical family, not a measured device.

Point-density evaluation is not an effect bounded by I. Inverse efficiency/unfolding needs operator-norm, conditioning and statistical control. A known scalar noiseless efficiency correction is an explicit exception.
The optimal coherent-sector POVM is not claimed achievable by ordinary gamma bins. Finite-count significance, actual detector statistics and real-nucleus realization remain outside the result.
This is scientific self-audit and our mathematical derivation, not a source-authored quantum-information result, experiment, Human review or paper admission.
